capabilities: Record player actions, oracle questions, and dice rolls in a code-block notation
Tag NPCs, locations, and story threads and index their mentions automatically
Track progress with clocks, tracks, and timers
Browse campaigns through six sidebar views (dashboard, tag browser, trackers, random events)
Insert campaign, session, and scene templates from the command palette
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. It implements the Solo TTRPG Notation system v2.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in structure for documenting solo tabletop RPG play, making it hard to track NPCs, story threads, and progress clocks across sessions.

relations.evidence: The notation system is inspired by the Sigil Standard.

summary: Solo TTRPG session logger that records actions, oracle rolls, and dice results in code-block notation and indexes NPCs, threads, and trackers into six views.
